devdoc.author: Tellor Inc.
devdoc.details: This is the Oracle contract which defines the functionality for the Tellor oracle, where reporters submit values on chain and users can retrieve values.

changeReportingLock(uint256).details: Changes reporting lock for reporters. Note: this function is only callable by the Governance contract.

changeTimeBasedReward(uint256).details: Changes time based reward for reporters. Note: this function is only callable by the Governance contract.

params._newTimeBasedReward: is the new time based reward.

getBlockNumberByTimestamp(bytes32,uint25.details: Returns the block number at a given timestamp

params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed
params._timestamp: is the timestamp to find the corresponding block number for

returns._0: uint256 block number of the timestamp for the given data ID

getCurrentReward(bytes32).details: Calculates the current reward for a reporter given tips and time based reward

params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed

getCurrentValue(bytes32).details: Returns the current value of a data feed given a specific ID

params._queryId: is the ID of the specific data feed

returns._0: bytes memory of the current value of data

getReportTimestampByIndex(bytes32,uint25.details: Returns the timestamp of a reported value given a data ID and timestamp index

params._index: is the index of the timestamp
params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed

returns._0: uint256 timestamp of the given queryId and index

getReporterByTimestamp(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns the address of the reporter who submitted a value for a data ID at a specific time

params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed
params._timestamp: is the timestamp to find a corresponding reporter for

returns._0: address of the reporter who reported the value for the data ID at the given timestamp

getReporterLastTimestamp(address).details: Returns the timestamp of the reporter's last submission

returns._0: uint256 timestamp of the reporter's last submission

getReportingLock().details: Returns the reporting lock time, the amount of time a reporter must wait to submit again

getReportsSubmittedByAddress(address).details: Returns the number of values submitted by a specific reporter address

params._reporter: is the address of a reporter

returns._0: uint256 of the number of values submitted by the given reporter

getTimeBasedReward().details: Returns the time based reward for submitting a value

getTimeOfLastNewValue().details: Returns the timestamp for the last value of any ID from the oracle

returns._0: uint256 of timestamp of the last oracle value

getTimestampCountById(bytes32).details: Returns the number of timestamps/reports for a specific data ID

params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed

returns._0: uint256 of the number of timestamps/reports for the given data ID

getTimestampIndexByTimestamp(bytes32,uin.details: Returns the index of a reporter timestamp in the timestamp array for a specific data ID

params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed
params._timestamp: is the timestamp to find in the timestamps array

returns._0: uint256 of the index of the reporter timestamp in the array for specific ID

getTipsById(bytes32).details: Returns the amount of tips available for a specific query ID

params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed

returns._0: uint256 of the amount of tips added for the specific ID

getTipsByUser(address).details: Returns the amount of tips made by a user

params._user: is the address of the user

returns._0: uint256 of the amount of tips made by the user

getValueByTimestamp(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns the value of a data feed given a specific ID and timestamp

params._queryId: is the ID of the specific data feed
params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look for data

returns._0: bytes memory of the value of data at the associated timestamp

removeValue(bytes32,uint256).details: Removes a value from the oracle. Note: this function is only callable by the Governance contract.

params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed
params._timestamp: is the timestamp of the data value to remove

submitValue(bytes32,bytes,uint256,bytes).details: Allows a reporter to submit a value to the oracle

params._nonce: is the current value count for the query id
params._queryData: is the data used to fulfill the data query
params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed. Equals keccak256(_queryData) for non-legacy IDs
params._value: is the value the user submits to the oracle

tipQuery(bytes32,uint256,bytes).details: Adds tips to incentivize reporters to submit values for specific data IDs.

params._queryData: is required for IDs greater than 100, informs reporters how to fulfill request. See github.com/tellor-io/dataSpecs
params._queryId: is ID of the specific data feed
params._tip: is the amount to tip the given data ID

verify().details: Used during the upgrade process to verify valid Tellor Contracts
